summary_en: Cypress Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 187,500 shares (1.46% of outstanding shares) for a maximum 300 million yen through market purchase from late November 2026 to February 28, 2027. The buyback aims to enhance shareholder returns, improve capital efficiency, and mitigate supply-demand effects from a concurrent share offering.
title_en: Notice regarding the decision of matters concerning acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 4, 2026, Cypress Holdings' board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury shares under Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and the company's Articles of Incorporation. The company is permitted to acquire up to 187,500 shares, representing 1.46% of outstanding shares (12,800,200 shares excluding treasury stock as of August 31, 2026), for a maximum total amount of 300 million yen. The shares will be purchased through market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The acquisition period begins on the business day following settlement of a concurrent public share offering, which is expected to settle between November 19 and November 25, 2026 depending on the pricing decision date (November 11–16, 2026). The period extends through February 28, 2027. No ceiling price per share has been specified.

The company states three purposes for the buyback: strengthening returns to shareholders, improving capital efficiency, and mitigating the supply-demand impact of the concurrent share offering. The company also intends to use acquired shares as part of future capital policy. The board delegated authority for final execution details to the representative director and president. Market conditions may result in partial or no execution of the authorization.
